frame_plan.scope: Event-driven frame plan for the current ten curated clips, based on local material; no art generated, training performed or acceptance status promoted.

time_semantics.all_key_and_candidate_timestamps: Relative to the downloaded archive clip origin, matching subjects/*/source.json key_times. These are not excerpt-relative times.
time_semantics.interval_convention: [start, end), matching curation; all proposed times lie inside the existing curated interval.
time_semantics.precision: Candidate timestamp labels bracket visible events; snap to decoded source frames and confirm ordering/contact before authoring. Decimal precision is not artistic certainty.

budget_definitions.authored_pose_keys: Existing four accepted still-key drawings plus proposed new action/view/contact anchors.
budget_definitions.breakdowns: Separately budgeted authored transition drawings for arcs, attachment and overlap; not automatically approved and not included in target_pose_key_count.
budget_definitions.procedural_samples: Timing/angle checks or rendered transformations; do not count as new authored drawings.
budget_definitions.delivery_frames: Rendered samples at a chosen delivery rate, including holds, rigs, procedural transforms and possible inbetweens. Frame count is not drawing count.
budget_definitions.uncertainty: Counts are bounded first-pass production allocations, not measured minimums or quality predictions. Playback can require more or fewer drawings; the 100-clip arithmetic assumes the same complexity mix, not an archive-wide estimate.

current_ten_totals.delivery_frame_calculation: sum per clip ceil((interval_end - interval_start) * 12); do not round duration before multiplying.
current_ten_totals.inbetween_frame_count: Not determined by subtracting drawing counts: authored timings need not land on unique delivery samples, and holds/rig/procedural samples are not authored inbetweens.

hundred_clip_scenarios.name: Actual current accepted art to 100 clips at the same complexity mix
hundred_clip_scenarios.assumption: Only the current 40 accepted pose-key drawings exist. The additional 90 clips and their art are hypothetical and uncurated; no new art has been produced by this plan.
hundred_clip_scenarios.calculation: 100-clip target pose drawings 10*79=790; only40 accepted drawings actually exist, so790-40=750 additional pose drawings; add240 breakdown drawings:750+240=990 new authored drawings;40+990=1030 total. Procedural phase checks and4730 rendered frames are separate from authored drawings.

hundred_clip_scenarios.name: Hypothetical fully seeded 100 clips: four accepted poses already supplied for each clip
hundred_clip_scenarios.assumption: Hypothetical only: assumes400 accepted drawings, but only40 actually exist today. This scenario understates work remaining from the actual current state and must not be used as the actual-current remaining budget.
hundred_clip_scenarios.calculation: Pose keys 10*79=790, including 10*40=400 assumed accepted and 10*39=390 new; breakdowns 10*24=240; new authoring 390+240=630; total authoring 790+240=1030; rendered frames 10*473=4730.

hundred_clip_scenarios.name: Greenfield 100 clips at the same mix
hundred_clip_scenarios.assumption: No preaccepted drawings; author all target poses and breakdowns.
hundred_clip_scenarios.calculation: 790 new pose-key drawings + 240 breakdown drawings = 1030 new authored drawings; 4730 delivery frames is separate.

stills: Preserve accepted four key times, selected drawing identity and source-event/crop relation.
Review every new pose and breakdown against source: contour/volume, contact, near/far overlap and masking.
New art remains proposed until independent still review passes; current still acceptance does not establish motion quality.
playback: Inspect source and candidate at normal speed and slow/stepped playback over the full curated interval.
Check event order, acceleration/settle, arcs, foot/pedal/fingertip attachment, occlusion continuity, cropping and temporal line stability.
Check procedural rotation phase/direction and aliasing, hub stability and masks.
Only after playback review and any repairs may motion_bar change; training eligibility requires its own gate.
